title: refactor(ci): consolidate workflows and upgrade Node to 18
author: Jamie Thompson
description: Refactor CI pipelines and upgrade Node.js runtime to 18 across GitHub Actions workflows. This PR consolidates duplicated build/test logic into a reusable workflow, pins action versions, improves cache keys and cache restore strategy, splits long-running matrices to reduce wall time, stabilizes the docker publish step with retries and backoff, and adjusts release automation to support semantic-release canary tagging for pre-releases. Also includes small dependency bumps used only by CI (actions and helper scripts) and updates CI badges in the README. Motivations: reduce CI flakiness, speed up PR feedback loops, and simplify maintenance of workflows across repositories. See commits and changed files for specifics.
commits: feat(ci): upgrade workflows to Node 18 and update setup-node usage
fix(ci): add exponential backoff + retry to docker publish step to avoid intermittent 429s
perf(ci): improve cache key generation to include package-lock hash and partial restore
test(ci): add smaller per-package matrices to reduce resources and runtime
docs: update README CI badges and contributing guide references
review_comments: Aisha Patel: Overall this looks great. Two requests: 1) can we add a small smoke test after the cache restore to assert node_modules resolved before running the build to fail faster, 2) please call out any changes that will affect on-prem private installs in the PR description (e.g., runner labels).

Jamie Thompson (author): Added smoke check after cache restore and called out self-hosted runner label changes in the description and release notes. The smoke check is a lightweight 'node -v && npm ci --package-lock-only' step so it doesn't alter production artifacts.

Ethan Cho: Noted an intermittent flake in e2e that was caused by an ordering race in docker publish; the retry/backoff change makes sense. Please also note whether this increases run time for release jobs and whether there's a rollout plan.

Jamie Thompson (author): Release job got an extra ~15s expected due to retries; added metrics to release workflow to emit duration counts and added a canary release flow so we can validate before full release. Rollout plan: enable on main, monitor metrics for 48h, then remove canary if stable.

Marina Alvarez: Suggest pinning actions to specific minor versions for stability; I see we pinned to major v4 where available which is fine but please add a follow-up todo to pin SHAs for critical actions.
Samir Gupta: LGTM after a small comment on cache key entropy; prefer including package-lock hash instead of node-version to avoid unnecessary misses across patch upgrades.
release_notes: Refactor CI workflows, upgrade Node to 18, pin actions, improve caching and stabilize docker publish. Speeds up PR feedback and reduces flakiness. No runtime application changes.
